title: fix(core): honor remark syntax extensions in public AST
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Make the editor's public AST use the configured remark parse pipeline when remark plugins are present, so syntax extensions such as `remark-math` are reflected consistently in `getAst()`, change events, outline generation, and AST-based plugins.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

Remark syntax extensions must participate while Markdown is parsed. The previous path converted CodeMirror's Lezer tree to mdast first and only then ran remark transformers, so extensions could not create nodes such as `inlineMath`. Widgets could render the extended syntax through a separate parser while public AST consumers still received plain text.

- Issue: none
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): none
- OpenSpec change: not required (bug fix; no public API change)

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/core`:
  - route public AST parsing through the existing full remark pipeline when remark plugins are configured
  - retain custom-parser precedence and the plugin-free incremental Lezer fast path
  - share a one-entry parse cache between public AST and widget consumers
  - isolate cached trees from transformer, public API, and widget mutations
  - cancel stale delayed change work before silent document loads
- `packages/plugin-math`:
  - cover `getAst()`, change callbacks, and semantic outline text for inline math
- `packages/plugin-wordcount`:
  - verify editor-mode counting matches standalone counting and excludes math nodes
- `apps/electron-demo`: none
- `openspec/`: none

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿 (35 files, 546 tests)
- [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过
- [x] `pnpm typecheck` passes / 类型检查通过
- [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例：
  - public AST and `onChange` expose `inlineMath`
  - outline uses semantic math node values
  - wordcount excludes formula content
  - parser cache executes transforms once per source
  - cached AST is isolated from plugin, widget, and public mutations, including cycles and common built-ins
  - silent document and range replacements cancel stale delayed changes
- [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证：
  - math renders in the native demo UI
  - outline shows `Energy E=mc^2`
  - wordcount reports 3 words while excluding formula content
